description: This file defines a Redis-based cache for embeddings, including classes for managing Redis connections, embedding storage, and serialization/deserialization of documents and embeddings.

classes.name: RedisEmbeddingsCache
classes.description: Implements a cache for embeddings using Redis, with initialization and credential handling.

classes.name: CacheBackedEmbeddings
classes.description: Extends Embeddings to include Redis-backed storage for document embeddings, with methods for embedding queries and documents.

classes.name: EncoderBackedStore
classes.description: A generic store that serializes/deserializes values for storage, supporting key encoding and value serialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Redis client and creates a RedisByteStore for caching embeddings.

methods.name: embedQuery
methods.description: Embeds a query and then quits the Redis client.

methods.name: embedDocuments
methods.description: Embeds multiple documents, fetching from store or computing missing vectors.

methods.name: fromBytesStore
methods.description: Creates a CacheBackedEmbeddings instance from a byte store with optional namespace and Redis client.

methods.name: mget
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values from the store, decoding them.

methods.name: mset
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs after encoding.

methods.name: mdelete
methods.description: Deletes multiple keys from the store.

methods.name: yieldKeys
methods.description: Asynchronously yields keys with optional prefix.

methods.name: createDocumentStoreFromByteStore
methods.description: Creates a document store with serialization/deserialization from a byte store.
